SELECT sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p
  ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN (
    SELECT l_partkey, avg(l_quantity) AS avg_qty
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
) AS avgq
  ON l.l_partkey = avgq.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
  AND l.l_quantity < 0.2 * avgq.avg_qty
LIMIT 1;

WITH avg_qty AS (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS limit_qty
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem li
JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN avg_qty a ON li.l_partkey = a.l_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND li.l_quantity < a.limit_qty
LIMIT 1;
